system.description: A Focus for a master of deduction who uses evidence to find the truth.

abilities.name: Investigative Knack
abilities.description: Initiate a period of investigation during which low perception, interaction, or lie-detection results are treated as 9, increasing to 12 at tier 3.

abilities.name: Sense Weakness
abilities.description: After observing a creature for a round, learn its special weaknesses and deal it 1 additional damage with attacks.

abilities.name: Sleuthing
abilities.description: While pursuing a target or investigating a mystery, ask the GM one question about the task and receive a short helpful answer.

abilities.name: Master of Disguise
abilities.description: Create a disguise as a Last action, and treat a disguise roll below 6 as a 6, increasing to 9 at tier 3.

abilities.name: Out of Harm's Way
abilities.description: After succeeding on a dodge task, immediately move an immediate distance even when it is not your turn.

abilities.name: Combat Prowess
abilities.description: Choose melee or ranged weapon attacks; attacks of that type deal 1 additional damage.

abilities.name: Ditch Assumption
abilities.description: After careful investigation, learn one false assumption in the current investigation or eliminate one suspect from several possibilities.

abilities.name: Defend and Respond
abilities.description: After blocking or dodging a melee attack, immediately make a melee attack against the attacker, once per turn.

abilities.name: Lead by Inquiry
abilities.description: Allies who take a ten-hour recovery with you are trained in perception and lie detection while they remain within long range.

abilities.name: Defuse Situation
abilities.description: Through social misdirection, prevent a living foe from attacking anyone or anything for one round after a successful interaction task.

abilities.name: Infer Thoughts
abilities.description: After observing or interacting with a level 4 or lower target for a round, read its surface thoughts while you can see and hear it.

abilities.name: Knowing the Unknown
abilities.description: Use appropriate resources to ask the GM one question and receive a general answer whose difficulty reflects how obscure it is.
